subject: Priya Shah (SDE2) — final pay mix and sign-off
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offer recommendation for Priya Shah (SDE2) — request for pay mix sign-off

Team,

We completed final interviews for Priya Shah (referred by TalentBridge). She is a strong SDE2 candidate — solid systems design, 3 strong take-home tasks, and great culture fit. Hiring manager (Karthik) recommends moving forward. Below is the proposed standard offer (aligned to band 3B):

- Base salary: $150,000
- Target bonus: 12% (annual)
- Equity: 6,000 RSUs over 4 years (25/25/25/25)
- Start date requested: 2027-01-17

Rationale:
- Peer comp checks put her base near the low-mid of band 3B; we skew equity to be competitive given limited cash flexibility.
- Total cash + 4yr equity value ~ $230k (rough market-adjusted estimate).

Attachments: Priya_Shah_resume.pdf, comp_worksheet_priya.xlsx (calculator with total target comp and band alignment).

Ask: Marissa — please confirm comp band alignment and whether we should re-balance to more base or more RSUs. Laura and Markus — please confirm headcount/budget code and approve to extend offer if comp band is OK.

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Offer recommendation for Priya Shah (SDE2) — request for pay mix sign-off

On Fri, 11 Dec 2026 at 09:12, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> We completed final interviews for Priya Shah...

Thanks for the summary, Karthik — agree candidate looks solid and the proposed package is within band 3B, but suggest a small tweak to improve acceptance odds given competing offers in market: move $7,500 of base to RSUs (i.e., reduce base to $142,500 and increase RSUs to 7,000). That keeps OTE similar but boosts long-term upside (candidates at her level are equity-sensitive).

Notes on compliance with bands: see attached comp_bands_q4_2026.pdf — band 3B base range $135k–$165k, target total comp ranges shown. Your comp_worksheet shows total value ok after this tweak.

If we do the tweak, we should confirm budget owner comfortable with equity delta (Markus), and ensure we set vesting cliff and acceleration as standard. Also recommend including a 10% first-year pro-rated sign-on if needed (approval needed if >$10k).

Marissa
Sr. Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Offer recommendation for Priya Shah (SDE2) — request for pay mix sign-off

Folks —

Couple of operational points before we issue the offer:
- Headcount: Hiring request HR-6123 is approved for Q1; I'm attaching headcount_request_6123.pdf for reference. Budget code is ENG-PLAT-Q1-03.
- Offer authority: Standard SDE2 pay decisions up to the top of band are approvable by hiring manager with Total Rewards sign-off. Anything outside band or sign-on > $10k needs director-level approval.
- Equity terms: We use 4yr vesting with 1yr cliff; no special acceleration by default.

Marissa — can you confirm whether the $7,500 shift to RSUs keeps us below the band cap for equity grants? Markus — please confirm budget owner (finance) ok with the additional RSU headroom.

Once we have those confirmations, Aditya, can you please approve so TalentBridge can get the accepted offer out? Karthik should confirm start date and recruiter to prepare standard employment paperwork.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
